brief:
Settler terrorism has intensified into a coordinated siege campaign against Palestinian villages, according to Ma'an wire. The escalation represents a shift from sporadic violent incidents to systematic restrictions on movement and access to resources in affected communities. Residents report that armed settlers are blocking roads and preventing entry and exit from multiple locations.

The siege strategy compounds existing restrictions already facing Palestinians under occupation, creating severe hardship for villagers unable to move freely or access essential services and supplies. Schools, markets, and medical facilities have become difficult or impossible to reach. The coordinated nature of the attacks suggests organization beyond individual incidents, raising concerns about the scope and duration of the campaign against these communities.
title: Settler attacks escalate into village sieges
